multiforge_debug.configuration.title: MultiForge Debug Client
multiforge_debug.configuration.group.ove: Which overlays to draw. Turning one off also stops the server sending its data.
multiforge_debug.configuration.group.hud: How many rows each on-screen panel draws.
multiforge_debug.configuration.group.ren: How far the in-world seams and pin boxes extend.
Top-left block: server build, region count, worst region MSPT.
Top-left per-region detail rows, under the summary block.
Right-hand panel of live reroute/ownership warnings.
In-world seams where two adjacent chunks belong to different regions.
Translucent per-chunk tick-cost tint on the ground.
Wireframe boxes around operator-created region pins.
multiforge_debug.configuration.hud.regio: Maximum region rows to draw before truncating.
multiforge_debug.configuration.hud.viola: Maximum violation rows to draw. The client retains 200 regardless.
multiforge_debug.configuration.render.bo: Chunks in each direction from the player to test for region seams.
multiforge_debug.configuration.render.yB: Blocks below the player that seams and pin boxes extend.
multiforge_debug.configuration.render.yA: Blocks above the player that seams and pin boxes extend.
